name: Torre Moeve (Torre Cepsa)

position.source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/188396764 (centroid of the outline; long axis at 101.6°)

rights.note: Foster + Partners, 2004–2008, opened in 2009 as Torre Repsol, then Torre Caja Madrid / Torre Bankia, Torre Cepsa (2014) and Torre Moeve (2024). Structural engineers Halvorson and Partners and Gilsanz Murray Steficek.

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q519568_torre_moeve.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. Plan and heights from the detailed OpenStreetMap building:parts; the plan is made symmetric (differences under 10 cm). Main façade (+Z) = the south glass face: the broad glass faces look north and south and the ends towards the Paseo de la Castellana are the blind steel cores; the entrance hall is glazed on both broad faces. Simplified: the cores are plain steel prisms with plate joints and the black strip of the end faces; the office façades are flat glass with floor lines (no mullions); the transfer platforms show a stylised steel W truss; the wind turbines under the frame and the rooftop equipment are omitted. Uncertain: the exact depth of the steel frame and the look of the platform trusses.
